text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Now let's see a big, bright 
smile~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: L-Like this...?

Today was a New Year's interview for a 
magazine. Nice Nature was participating in 
the shoot dressed in gorgeous attire, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... They're all nice, but I feel like 
Nature-san's usual charm could, you 
know... stand out even more...
choice_data_list:
You're right, their expression does look a 
bit stiff...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha~... I'm sorry. I just feel like 
the outfit is totally wearing me.

"That shouldn't be the case. If you could 
just relax a little more, I'm sure we 
could get much better photos."

Nice Nature's natural, unforced self. In 
order to bring that out—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nei-chan! Welcome! It's just finished 
simmering!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait!! The shopping district's imoni 
party?! ...W-We're shooting here?!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
I see, that sounds like a great off-shot 
photo! Nature-san, let's definitely get a 
shot of you eating!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, this looks so delicious... Is it 
really okay to have this while on duty?
choice_data_list: This is part of the job too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, well... In that case, I guess... I 
am pretty hungry... so I'll gladly take 
you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the food. Hoff, huff... 
*slurp*...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...! So deliiiicious~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Oh! That expression just now...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here comes a good breeze! ...And once it 
hits, you give it a gentle lift!

text_block_list.name: Familiar Boy
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! The kite's flying~! Thank you, Nice 
sis!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's Nice Nature! Once 
this is over, we're heading back to the 
imoni party~
choice_data_list: You're really good at riding the wind!
You're so good at riding the wind!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, I used to play with mini 
kites from candy shops, y'know~. Something 
like this is an absolute piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Children
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! Big sis, do mine too! —Fly my kite 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Okay, okay! I'll take care of you 
one by one.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew, elementary schoolers sure are full 
of energy these days. Time for a little 
rest, a little rest...

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meoow.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hey, it's Moo-chan from the milk shop. 
Is this his walking route or something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are. Friendly as ever, 
aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You want me to scratch you here? There, 
tickle-tickle-tickle~~♪
And so, the shoot progressed smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
We got some great photos~. Look, there are 
so many good ones, I can't decide which to 
pick.

We check the photos together, one by one. 
In every single one of them, Nice Nature 
wore a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know I could make a face like 
this...
choice_data_list:
Your charm is really overflowing, isn't 
it?
Your charm is just overflowing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...! ...W-What are you even saying? It's 
just that the camera operator is really 
skilled~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing too, Trainer. To think you 
know this many places where I can truly 
relax.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you're totally head over 
heels for me~? Tickle, tickle~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Because it's my job to bring out your 
brilliance.

Because it's my job to bring out your 
brilliance

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Wow, as expected of her Trainer! To bring 
out both her running performance and inner 
charm!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
In that case... it might be best to leave 
the photo selection to them as well!
choice_data_list:
With a photo of a soothed smile at the 
imoni party!

I think a shot of everyone happily flying 
kites would be great.

We can't skip a two-shot with a cat, can 
we!

text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature gathered around a hot pot with 
the people from the shopping district. 
It's a heartwarming photo that truly 
captures their closeness.
choice_data_list: Let's share this smile with the world!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Geez! What is this itchy feeling...

Nice Nature engrossed in flying kites 
together with the children. A photo that 
truly captures her caring and approachable 
nature.
choice_data_list:
I really like this photo, what do you 
think?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, geez! Just do whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
! Totally, totally. That cat's face is a 
national treasure, seriously~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, seriously, forget about that already!
